description: This Java class implements a MongoDB connection pool listener that reports connection pool statistics to Kamon metrics, including connection counts and wait queue sizes.

classes.name: KamonConnectionPoolListener
classes.description: A listener that tracks MongoDB connection pool events and updates Kamon metrics accordingly.

classes.name: PoolMetric
classes.description: Inner class managing individual pool metrics such as size, checked out count, and wait queue size.

methods.name: KamonConnectionPoolListener
methods.description: Constructor initializing the listener with a metric name.

methods.name: connectionPoolOpened
methods.description: Handles the event when a connection pool is opened, creating new metrics for the server.

methods.name: connectionPoolClosed
methods.description: Handles the event when a connection pool is closed, removing metrics for the server.

methods.name: connectionCheckedOut
methods.description: Increments the checked out count when a connection is checked out.

methods.name: connectionCheckedIn
methods.description: Decrements the checked out count when a connection is checked in.

methods.name: waitQueueEntered
methods.description: Increments the wait queue size when a thread enters the wait queue.

methods.name: waitQueueExited
methods.description: Decrements the wait queue size when a thread exits the wait queue.

methods.name: connectionAdded
methods.description: Increments the pool size when a new connection is added.

methods.name: connectionRemoved
methods.description: Decrements the pool size when a connection is removed.
